note: Every dataset the Model Lab may use. A dataset not listed here is not used. ai-lab/tests/test_lab.py checks each file's SHA-256, the split rules and that no patient data is present.

datasets.ocr: ai-lab/synth/ocr.py --seed 7 (Tesseract 5.3.4, psm 6, eng); texts in ocr/
datasets.license: Doctine-owned (generated by Doctine code; every name, lab, doctor and value is fictional)
datasets.schema: the read schema in netlify/functions/scan.mjs (READ_TOOL): lab_results {test, value, unit, range, flag}; medicines {name, form, strength, frequency, timing, duration}; date, facility, doctor
datasets.split_rule: by layout family and by facility name: no family, lab, clinic or doctor name in test appears in train
limitations: Printed text only: no handwriting, no Indian-language script, no photos of real paper.
17 common tests and 10 common brands; real reports carry hundreds.
Benchmark-sized (240 documents). Far too small to train on; a training set would be generated separately and checked for overlap with this test split.
